newsitem.title: USA: ALARIS contract dispute may impact earnings.
newsitem.headline: ALARIS contract dispute may impact earnings.

text.p: ALARIS Medical Inc said on Monday that its continuing negotiations to resolve its contract dispute with Cal Pacifico of California could result in a non-recurring impact on future financial results.
ALARIS said it is pursuing civil and criminal actions in Mexico against certain responsible parties of two affiliated Mexican companies of Cal Pacifico.
The legal actions are in response to a June 11 lockout by Cal Pacifico, which idled 1,200 employees at the company's two maquiladora operations in Tijuana.

ALARIS has requested that the district attorney of Tijuana take possession of all of the assets related to ALARIS Medical's manufacturing, pending resolution of the dispute which would allow manufacturing operations to continue.
The company remains hopeful that a successful outcome will be achieved in the short term.
ALARIS Medical Systems Inc, the operating subsidiary of ALARIS Medical Inc, manufactures disposable intravenous administration sets under contract with Cal Pacifico.
The two Mexican companies associated with Cal Pacifico are Ensambles Medicos SA de C.V. and Arplamed SA de C.V.
